python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/user/workspace/status_board/board_state.json')
state=json.loads(p.read_text())
updates={
 'BE-203': {'status':'IN_REVIEW','owner':'Platform On-Call','priority':'P1','sla':'at_risk','resolution':'Validation: peak-load event consumer lag reported; review pending.'},
 'BE-207': {'status':'RESOLVED','owner':'Data Ops','priority':'P2','sla':'within_sla','resolution':'Validation: warehouse snapshot checksum drift reported; checksum verification recorded.'},
 'BE-211': {'status':'IN_PROGRESS','owner':'Runtime Team','priority':'P1','sla':'overdue','resolution':'Validation: worker-pool token refresh loop reported; runtime investigation underway.'},
}
for card in state['cards']:
    if card['id'] in updates:
        card.update(updates[card['id']])
Path('/tmp/board_payload.json').write_text(json.dumps(state))
PY
curl -sS -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:18114/api/save -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Queue: backend' --data-binary @/tmp/board_payload.json

mkdir -p /home/user/workspace/status_board/out
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, urllib.request
url='http://127.0.0.1:18114/api/state'
with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as r:
    state=json.load(r)
ids=['BE-203','BE-207','BE-211']
cards=[c for c in state['cards'] if c['id'] in ids]
assert [c['id'] for c in cards] == ids
expected={
 'BE-203':('IN_REVIEW','Platform On-Call','P1','at_risk'),
 'BE-207':('RESOLVED','Data Ops','P2','within_sla'),
 'BE-211':('IN_PROGRESS','Runtime Team','P1','overdue'),
}
for c in cards:
    status,owner,priority,sla=expected[c['id']]
    assert (c['status'],c['owner'],c['priority'],c['sla'])==(status,owner,priority,sla),c
    assert c['resolution']
assert len(state['cards']) == 8
assert state['revision'] == 1
out={'queue':'backend','cards':cards}
with open('/home/user/workspace/status_board/out/backend_export.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print('API state verified; revision',state['revision'])
print(json.dumps(cards,indent=2))
print('export:',open('/home/user/workspace/status_board/out/backend_export.json').read())
PY
